title: Tells you to keep it secret or stay on a video call
why: Scammers isolate you so no one can tell you it is a scam. A genuine officer or bank will always let you check with someone.
examples: Do not tell anyone about this case, stay on the video call until we finish.
This is strictly confidential. Do not inform your bank or family.
safe: Do not share OTP with anyone.
Please stay on the line while we transfer you to the billing team.
